items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: So two or three times I did, I sparred with him two or three times a week.

ctx.x: There were some questionable experiences we all had.

Yeah, I know everyone went through those things. But the job up at Lake Tahoe was a nice job. It was Globben's (PHONETIC) Chalet and it was a place built out over the lake. And the lake had not become polluted. You'd dive in and drink water. And that summer Max Baer was up there training for his second fight with Carnera. We had to sit around at night and watch them show movies of his first fight. And he couldn't get a sparring partner and I guess you can guess what I'm leading up to, because at that time I was…
That's really interesting. That was Lake Tahoe. That's a magnificent piece of water up there.
